Class FaissNative

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.vector.faiss.FaissNative
public final class FaissNative extends Object
Native library loader and error handling for FAISS FFM bindings.

Loads libfaiss_c from ~/.wayang/lib/ via JDK 25 Foreign Function & Memory (FFM) API.

      public static void checkError(int rc)
      Check the return code from a FAISS C function. FAISS C API returns 0 on success, non-zero on error.
      Parameters:
      rc - return code from a FAISS C function
      Throws:
      FaissException - if rc != 0
